sense.plainEnglish: Begin Play starts one timer. The hunter looks every fifth of a second. A closed door blocks the look. A hit sets the alert flag. A miss should decay it. A dropped bottle calls that same look instead of growing a second brain.
sense.whyGame: Tracing every frame sees through pauses, and a private audio brain writes a flag the stalk never reads.

expansions.title: The glimpse
expansions.detail: The timer is the quiet look.

expansions.title: A miss
expansions.detail: Without a decay the hunter stays sure forever.

quiz.prompt: How often does the beginner hunter look, when nothing sudden has happened?
choices: Every 0.2 seconds, from the timer Begin Play started
Only when the player presses use

quiz.prompt: The sense excerpt assigns Alert = 1 on a hit. When does that line run?
choices: Only after the trace reports a hit
Every time the timer fires, hit or miss
quiz.why: The assignment is gated on the hit.

quiz.prompt: A closed door stands between the hunter and the player. What does the visibility trace do?
choices: It sets the alert flag anyway
quiz.why: The channel stops on the door.

quiz.prompt: A miss never decays the alert flag. What does the hunter stay?
choices: Already calm, if a miss cleared suspicion

quiz.prompt: A bottle hits the floor. What should it call?
choices: The same Sense event the timer uses

quiz.prompt: A missed horror trace should let the alert flag decay.
quiz.why: A miss should decay, or the hunter never forgives.

quiz.prompt: You move the look onto the frame loop so glimpses feel fresh. What keeps running in a pause?
choices: The trace, for a hunter that should be still
No trace at all, if the frame loop always paused
quiz.why: The timer can stop. A frame trace is easy to leave on.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the glimpse assignment?
choices: Alert set to 1 when the trace hits

quiz.prompt: Where does a decay belong if you add one?
choices: On the miss path inside Sense
At the top of every frame, before the trace
quiz.why: Decay is the miss of the same event.

quiz.prompt: Who starts the glimpse timer?
quiz.why: One timer. Sense does not start another.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does Begin Play start one timer so the hunter looks every fifth of a second, with a closed door blocking the look?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What sees through a pause, and which flag goes unread, if the look is every frame or sound has its own brain?

use.plainEnglish: Use traces from the camera and calls Interact on a hit. A fuse, a hide lever, and a door handle share that name. The hunter does not run this graph. A miss logs and stops. It does not raise the alert flag and it does not yaw a door.
use.whyGame: If the hunter runs use, it turns valves. If use writes the alert flag, waving the crosshair at empty air alerts the house.

expansions.title: A fuse
expansions.detail: It implements Interact. The trace does not name the fuse.

expansions.title: A miss
expansions.detail: Log and return. Do not set Alert.

expansions.title: The hunter
expansions.detail: Sense is the hunter. Use is the player.

quiz.prompt: A fuse, a hide lever, and a door handle all need the player's press. What do they implement?
choices: Keeping hit points from going negative

quiz.prompt: The use excerpt calls ProcessEvent on Interact after a hit. What does the call accomplish?
choices: It runs the hit actor's own use function
It sets the hunter's alert flag
It swings the hinge by frame time

quiz.prompt: The trace hits a hide lever. What runs next?
choices: A cast that names the lever class
quiz.why: The lever answers the same function.

quiz.prompt: The hunter runs the player's use graph. What does the hunter start turning?
choices: Only suspicion, which would be the right job
No valves at all, if use ignored every AI

quiz.prompt: The miss branch sets the alert flag. What alerts the hunter?
choices: Waving the crosshair at empty air

quiz.prompt: A missed use trace should log and leave the hunter's alert flag alone.
Where should the horror use trace start?
choices: At the camera, along the crosshair
quiz.why: The player aims with the camera.

quiz.prompt: The miss path yaws the nearest door. What moves that the player did not use?
choices: Only suspicion, from the hunter look
quiz.why: A miss does not swing a door.

quiz.prompt: Which function is the player's press, not the hunter look?
choices: Interact after the use trace hits
quiz.why: Use and Sense are different events.

quiz.prompt: Art adds a new wall switch. What must it implement so the existing trace works?
choices: A new cast in the use graph

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does use trace from the camera and call Interact, while the hunter does not run this graph?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What turns valves, and what alerts an empty room, if the hunter runs use or use writes the alert flag?

door.plainEnglish: A door builds a timeline, keys a curve from closed to open, and plays it from the start. A flip writes whether it is open. The first use opens. The next closes. The creak calls Sense. Yawing the hinge every frame never finishes, so the creak has no end.
door.whyGame: Without a finished event the hunter never gets a clean audio cue, and a creak that subtracts health damages the player for opening a cupboard.

expansions.title: The curve
expansions.detail: PlayFromStart, keys at the two ends.

expansions.title: The creak
expansions.detail: It calls Sense. It does not touch health.

quiz.prompt: The player uses a door. What starts the swing?
choices: Adding frame time to the hinge yaw

quiz.prompt: FlipFlop writes IsOpen. What does the line record?
choices: Whether this swing opened or closed
Whether the hunter can see the player

quiz.prompt: The first use opened the door. What should the next use do?
choices: Close it, because the flip alternates
Open it again from the start

quiz.prompt: Tick yaws the hinge. What never arrives for the creak?
choices: A finished event, so the sound has no clean end
The overlap that started the idea of a door
The open bool on the actor
quiz.why: A yaw has no finished pin.

quiz.prompt: The creak plays. What should it call?
choices: Sense, so the hunter hears the door
A loss of hit points, so a cupboard hurts
quiz.why: The creak is a sound, not damage.

quiz.prompt: A door creak should subtract health.
Which pin is the end of the swing?
A trap on the door should hurt the player. Which event is that, instead of the creak?
choices: The flip of the open bool

quiz.prompt: Loading an open door by playing the curve from the start does what extra?
choices: It creaks, and the hunter hears a door you already opened
It shows the open pose in silence
It starts the player's use trace
quiz.why: Set the curve to the end.

quiz.prompt: Which call is the swing, not the hunter look?

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does a door play a curve from closed to open and record the result with a flip?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What audio cue never reaches the hunter, and who gets hurt, if there is no finished event or the creak subtracts health?

sight.plainEnglish: Seeing the player sets the alert flag. It does not subtract health. An attack calls damage, and that graph clamps. This lesson is single player, so a replication notify can be absent until a second machine exists.
sight.whyGame: Sense that subtracts on every glimpse kills the player for being seen, and it skips the clamp that makes zero a reachable down instead of a stuck negative.

expansions.title: A glimpse
expansions.detail: It writes the alert flag only.

expansions.title: A bite
expansions.detail: Any Damage clamps. Sight does not.

expansions.title: A second machine
expansions.detail: The moment co-op arrives, the write needs an authority gate and a notify that only presents.

quiz.prompt: The hunter confirms a sight. What should change?
choices: How many hit points the player has

quiz.prompt: Sense subtracts health on every glimpse. What kills the player?
choices: A door creak that only calls Sense
A miss that decays the flag

quiz.prompt: An attack should hurt. Which event starts that write?
The bite skips the clamp. What number becomes reachable that a down should pass through cleanly?
choices: A negative health that never quite hits zero
Exactly zero, as a deliberate down

quiz.prompt: This lesson is single player. What can be absent until a second machine exists?
quiz.why: One machine does not need a notify yet.

quiz.prompt: A confirmed sight should subtract health.
quiz.why: Sight sets the flag. Damage hurts.

quiz.prompt: A second machine joins and the client applies the bite locally. What will disagree?
quiz.why: That is when the authority gate arrives.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the bite, not the glimpse?
choices: A clamped health subtract inside damage
Alert set to 1 on a clear trace
Interact called from the use trace

quiz.prompt: The creak calls Sense and Sense subtracts health. What hurts the player for opening a cupboard?
choices: The sound path, which should only alert
A separate damage volume on the door
A miss that decays the flag
quiz.why: The creak is a look. The bite is damage.

quiz.prompt: You want zero to mean down, not a stuck negative. Where does that rule live?
quiz.why: The clamp is what makes zero reachable.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does seeing the player set the alert flag without subtracting health?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What kills the player for being seen if Sense subtracts on every glimpse and skips the clamp?
